packet.headline_seed: Dozens of Nigerian fishermen feared dead after Chad air strikes on Boko Haram
packet.description_seed: A fishermen's leader tells the BBC that 40 people are feared dead - either in the strikes or drowning as they tried to flee.

what: Dozens of Nigerian fishermen feared dead after Chad air strikes on Boko Haram

clean_source_blocks.text: A fishermen's leader tells the BBC that 40 people are feared dead - either in the strikes or drowning as they tried to flee.

Dozens of Nigerian fishermen are feared dead after Chad's military launched air strikes on Boko Haram militants in the Lake Chad region, a local fishermen's leader has told the BBC. Abubakar Gamandi Usman, chairman of Lake Chad Basin Fisheries Association of Nigeria, said several of the union's members were missing and estimated more than 40 had died. No bodies have yet been recovered but Usman believes some fishermen were hit by the strikes, while others drowned after attempting to flee in overloaded boats. Authorities in Chad and Nigeria have not commented, but on Sunday Chad's presidency said it had carried out retaliatory "intensive air strikes" on Boko Haram strongholds.

Abubakar Gamandi Usman, chairman of the Lake Chad Basin Fisheries Association of Nigeria, told the BBC that several members of the association are missing and estimated that more than 40 fishermen could have died in the incident. Some Nigerian fishermen have been feared dead following air strikes carried out by Chad’s military targeting Boko Haram positions in the Lake Chad region, with a local association leader warning that dozens may have been killed. Abubakar Gamandi Usman, chairman of the Lake Chad Basin Fisheries Association of Nigeria, told the BBC that several members of the association are missing and estimated that more than 40 fishermen could have died in the incident.

Unspecified numbers of people are feared dead following air strikes reportedly carried out by the Chadian military on suspected Boko Haram enclaves in the Lake Chad region. The strikes were said to have targeted two islands believed to be occupied by insurgents operating within the Lake Chad basin. AFP quoted a member of a civilian militia group and an official of a fishermen’s union as saying that many fishermen and other residents may have been caught in the bombardment. The operation was reportedly carried out by Chadian fighter jets as part of ongoing offensives against jihadist groups active around Lake Chad.

Dozens of Nigerian fishermen are feared dead after Chad's military launched air strikes on Boko Haram militants in the Lake Chad region, a local fishermen's leader has told the BBC.

Abubakar Gamandi Usman, chairman of Lake Chad Basin Fisheries Association of Nigeria, said several of the union's members were missing and estimated more than 40 had died.

No bodies have yet been recovered but Usman believes some fishermen were hit by the strikes, while others drowned after attempting to flee in overloaded boats.

Authorities in Chad and Nigeria have not commented, but on Sunday Chad's presidency said it had carried out retaliatory "intensive air strikes" on Boko Haram strongholds.

In a statement on Facebook, the presidency said it had responded to "unjustified attacks" by Boko Haram, which took place last Monday and Wednesday and targeted Chadian military bases near Lake Chad, reportedly killing at least 24 soldiers and two generals.

The Lake Chad basin is a huge region of waterways and swampland shared by Nigeria, Chad, Niger and Cameroon. It has long been a stronghold for Boko Haram and its rival faction, Islamic State West Africa Province (Iswap).

"After Boko Haram attacked Chadian forces, they retreated to islands they operate from. Fishermen also inhabit these islands," Usman told the BBC.

After Chad's air force began circling overhead on Friday, panic broke out, with both Boko Haram fighters and fishermen attempting to flee.

The search for the missing fishermen has been slow, Usman said, as some parts of Lake Chad are very deep. The local community also has limited access to canoes, as many are controlled by Boko Haram, Usman added.

"Boko Haram controls access to the fishing grounds, transporting fishermen to and from the fish market to the fishing site. Boko Haram collects taxes from these fishermen," he said.

payload.title: Kymmeniä nigerialaiskalastajia pelätään kuolleen Tšadin ilmaiskuissa Tšadjärvellä
payload.summary: Yli 40 nigerialaiskalastajan pelätään kuolleen Tšadin armeijan ilmaiskuissa Tšadjärven alueella. Kalastajajärjestön johtajan mukaan osa saattoi menehtyä pommituksissa ja osa hukkua paetessaan ylikuormitetuilla veneillä.
payload.content:
Yli 40 nigerialaiskalastajan pelätään kuolleen Tšadin armeijan ilmaiskuissa Tšadjärven alueella, jossa iskujen kerrotaan kohdistuneen Boko Haramin asemiin. Paikallisen kalastajajärjestön johtajan mukaan useita järjestön jäseniä on kateissa, mutta viranomaiset eivät ole vahvistaneet kuolonuhrien määrää eikä ruumiita ole lähdetietojen mukaan toistaiseksi löydetty.

## Kalastajia kateissa iskujen jälkeen

Lake Chad Basin Fisheries Association of Nigerian puheenjohtaja Abubakar Gamandi Usman arvioi, että yli 40 kalastajaa on voinut kuolla tapahtumissa. Hänen mukaansa osa kalastajista saattoi joutua suoraan ilmaiskujen kohteeksi, kun taas osa mahdollisesti hukkui yrittäessään paeta alueelta ylikuormitetuilla veneillä.

Tiedot kuolonuhreista ovat yhä alustavia. Saatavilla olevien tietojen mukaan useita kalastajia ja mahdollisesti myös muita alueen asukkaita oli lähellä pommitusten kohteita. Iskujen kerrotaan osuneen kahdelle saarelle, joiden uskottiin olevan kapinallisten käytössä Tšadjärven altaassa.

## Iskut kohdistuivat Boko Haramin alueisiin

Tšadin armeijan kerrotaan tehneen ilmaiskut Boko Haramin asemiin Tšadjärven alueella. Leadershipin lähdetietojen mukaan operaation toteuttivat Tšadin hävittäjät, ja iskujen kohteina olivat epäillyt Boko Haramin tukialueet tai enklaavit järvialueella.

AFP:n siteeraaman siviilijoukkojen jäsenen ja kalastajajärjestön edustajan mukaan pommituksissa saattoi jäädä alle sekä kalastajia että muita asukkaita. Tämä on keskeinen syy siihen, miksi kuolonuhrien määrästä on esitetty vakavia arvioita jo ennen virallista vahvistusta.

## Viranomaisilta ei vielä vahvistusta

Tšadin ja Nigerian viranomaiset eivät ole kommentoineet kalastajajärjestön kertomia kuolonuhriepäilyjä. Tšadin presidentin kanslia kertoi kuitenkin sunnuntaina, että maa oli tehnyt vastatoimena voimakkaita ilmaiskuja Boko Haramin tukikohtiin.

Iskujen kerrotaan liittyvän Tšadin käynnissä oleviin sotilasoperaatioihin Tšadjärven ympäristössä toimivia jihadistiryhmiä vastaan. Koska virallista uhrimäärää ei ole vahvistettu, tapahtumien tarkka kulku on edelleen epäselvä. Kalastajajärjestön huoli perustuu siihen, että useisiin sen jäseniin ei ole saatu yhteyttä iskujen jälkeen.
